info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Alerts-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Alerts API enables users to access alerts associated with their banking accounts. This API provides real-time notifications about account activities, including transaction alerts, low balance warnings, and security notifications. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and financial management tools that aim to enhance user engagement by keeping customers informed about their account statuses. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate timely alerts, improving customer experience and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all alerts associated with specific accounts, providing a comprehensive view of the notifications and events that require attention.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving alerts associated with accounts. This is used to specify the parameters for the query on the alerts relevant to the accounts.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of alerts for the account.

ListBankingAccountsAlertsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on accounts alerts. It is currently defined as a string.
